text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin has suffered an injury, so I've brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I can hear just fine without you yelling in my ear.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: This is nothing! It doesn't even hurt anymore. I'm good.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: There's nothing wrong so I can jump right back into trainin—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What?!
choice_data_list: We're here precisely because something appears to be wrong.
We're here precisely because something appears to be wrong.
I'll support you all the way!
I'll support you all the way!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What?!
choice_data_list: We're here precisely because something appears to be wrong.
We're here precisely because something appears to be wrong.
I'll support you all the way!
I'll support you all the way!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tch…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: We don't have the time to be resting! You of all people should know that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: If I keep getting held back like this, I'll be stuck as a weakling forever!
choice_data_list: You need to rest or else you'll never recover.
You need to rest or else you'll never recover.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Shut up, shut up, SHUT UP! Knock it off with your stupid reasoning!
choice_data_list: Would you rather I lie and only say what you want to hear?
Would you rather I lie and only say what you want to hear?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hell no! I'm not some dummy who wants that nonsense!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Damn it! This injury'd better heal at light speed—or else!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin agrees to go to bed, albeit rather reluctantly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm struck by the way she tries to get back on her feet despite her injury. I reassure her that I'll support her with all of my being.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uh… okay.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's good to hear, but sheesh… You're so irritating.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, be quiet! You're making me lose focu—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: OUCH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As a result, Narita Taishin ends up worsening her injury during training and is forced to rest.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tch! I'm not Ticket, you know!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Then again, shouting does make it hurt less, and I feel more fired up… This is really dumb, but…)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin shows off what she's got and blasts through her training for the day.
